reviews.title: A Speedy Upgrade for My Network Setup!
reviews.comment:
I recently purchased the 2.5GBase-T PCIe Network Adapter with RTL8125B chipset, and it has been a game-changer for my home network. This little powerhouse of a network card has made a significant difference in my data transfer speeds and overall network performance.
Installation was a breeze, as the card fits perfectly into a PCIe slot on my motherboard. The drivers were easy to find and install, and I was up and running in no time. I was pleasantly surprised by the compatibility and stability of this card with my system.
The most impressive aspect of this network adapter is, of course, its speed. The 2.5 Gigabit per second throughput is a substantial upgrade from my previous 1Gbps network card. I've noticed a significant improvement in file transfer speeds, online gaming, and 4K video streaming. Whether I'm transferring large files or enjoying lag-free online gameplay, this card has consistently delivered.
The RTL8125B chipset seems to be doing a fantastic job in managing network traffic. I haven't experienced any connectivity issues, and it's been rock-solid since I installed it. It also supports various advanced features like Wake-on-LAN, which is a handy addition for remote management.
Additionally, this network card remains cool and doesn't heat up excessively, even under heavy usage. It also features an efficient power management system, which is great for energy-conscious users.
In conclusion, the 2.5GBase-T PCIe Network Adapter with the RTL8125B chipset is an excellent addition to any PC or server setup. If you're looking for a cost-effective way to upgrade your network speeds and improve overall network performance, this card is a solid choice. I couldn't be happier with my purchase, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to make the leap to faster networking speeds without breaking the bank. Kudos to the makers of this fantastic product!

reviews.title: Works great, runs hot
reviews.comment:
I've been using this card for quite a while before writing this review and I can say for the cost, this card is worth it.  I get a full 2.5Gbit when connected to a 10G network and the card has no problem with flaking out, dropping packets or getting squirrelly even over transfer that take sever days.  The card keeps outputting like it's supposed to even under full load for extended periods of time.
One thing I will note is that it runs extremely hot, so just make sure you have good airflow over the surface of the card and it will be fine.  I am sure if you didn't have good movement of air you might run into a problem where the card overheats, but I never had this issue personally because I just made sure it  wasn't crammed right up against another card and there was no problem!
Hope you found this useful!

reviews.title: This is not plug and play on MacOS
reviews.comment: Installed on a 2010 MacPro running Mojave. The card was recognised but would not connect to internet. The Realtek site has drivers for MacOS 10.7 (Lion) which is over 10 years old. I hope the seller and manufacturer clarify which OS this has been tested on. (4 stars because I see it runs well on PCs. Good device just not for most Macs)
